item.title: Sonoma-based tech artist, Katherine Allbright’s exhibit opens at Sonoma Valley Library
item.description: Sonoma-based tech artist Katherine Allbright’s solo exhibition will be on display during open hours at the Sonoma Valley Library through Feb.28. The exhibit, “Open Book: From Paper to Pixels; Art in a Digital Age” will explore how traditional artworks expand into living, digital experiences. Through this exhibit, Allbright reflects on what it means to be […]

item.title: FISH steps up safety net services to meet residents’ growing needs
item.description: Thanks to the dedicated work of an increasing number of volunteers and generous community donations, FISH of Sonoma Valley was able to expand its critical safety net services to meet the growing needs of many Sonoma Valley residents, according to the nonprofit organization's Impact Report for 2025.

item.title: Award program for Sonoma’s artistic youth open for submissions
item.description: Sonoma's Cultural and Fine Arts Commission is accepting submissions for the 2026 Student Creative Artist Award Program, an annual opportunity for local art students to be recognized for their contributions in the visual, literary or performing arts. Submissions are due by March 18 and winners can receive up to $5,000.

item.title: Rare magnolias in full bloom at Sonoma Botanical Garden ahead of Feb. 14
item.description: Winter-blossoming trees including some rare magnolias and camellias are in peak bloom at the Sonoma Botanical Garden. Winter magnolia flowers on bare branches hold a unique beauty, making a trip to the Garden a sublime romantic date. item.title: Il Fuoco to remain open after holiday traffic drives profits
item.description: In a happy twist of fate, the owner of Il Fuoco Pizza, who thought his restaurant would fold due to financial struggles with the end of 2025, said the eatery will now remain open. The Boyes Hot Springs pizzeria at 18350 Sonoma Highway will continue to serve customers through February and for the time being. […]

item.title: Sonoma’s Peterson Mechanical opening Santa Rosa shop to expand ductwork manufacturing
item.description: A 111-year-old Sonoma County contractor is outfitting a new, larger ductwork manufacturing facility aimed at securing its competitive edge in the Bay Area.

item.title: Organizer of the annual free Thanksgiving Day dinner is Sonoma Valley’s 2026 Alcalde
item.description: The city has selected Gary Edwards as the 2026 Honorary Alcalde, a Sonoma resident and organizer of the annual free Thanksgiving Day dinner for the past 20 years.

item.title: Applications open for Sonoma Community Center’s 16th annual Trashion Fashion Runway Show
item.description: Sonoma Community Center's 16th annual fundraising runway show will accept applications through March 20.

item.title: California hotel sales in 2025 improve, but show sharp decline in North Bay
item.description: A new report shows hotel sales in the state showed some improvement in 2025, but not in the North Bay.
